offering_description.value: Savers sells secondhand clothing and household goods to shoppers through company-operated thrift stores. It buys donated goods from nonprofit partners, sorts and prices them, and sells some inventory in bulk to wholesale buyers.

primary_products.value: Secondhand clothing; footwear; fashion accessories; household goods; books

customer_segment.value: B2C: Shoppers buying secondhand clothing and household goods; B2B: Bulk buyers of used clothing and other secondhand goods

end_markets.value: Secondhand apparel and household goods retail; used goods wholesale

revenue_model.value: product sales: Individual secondhand items sold in stores and bulk lots sold to wholesale buyers

value_chain_position.value: retailer: Buys donated goods from nonprofit partners and sorts, prices, and sells them to shoppers; distributor: Sorts and sells used clothing and other goods in bulk to wholesale buyers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: Thrift store retail and bulk wholesale of secondhand goods from the same supply network

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated thrift stores; direct sales: Bulk sales directly to wholesale buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: State charitable solicitation and disclosure rules for collecting donated goods on behalf of nonprofit partners
